效率方面，依托全流程数智载体等，可有效解决传统模式下生产工序繁琐、产业协同低效、: In terms of efficiency, relying on full-process digital-intelligent carriers and other means can effectively solve problems under the traditional model such as cumbersome production processes, inefficient industrial coordination, and delayed demand response. At the same time, digital-intelligent technologies such as artificial intelligence will reshape the paradigm of industrial innovation, accelerate the iteration of core technologies, and promote the efficient output of disruptive, original technologies.

围绕高端算力芯片等“卡脖子”领域，强化机制、资金、平台等资源支持: For "chokepoint" fields such as high-end computing power chips, strengthen support through resources such as mechanisms, funding, and platforms.
